title: docs(skills): name the percent formula return type in the data field-types rules
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

`Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #35565 (#35047). Parent: #35047.

## What will be incomplete
`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (about line 130) lists a formula's `returnType` as number, text, boolean, date and currency. Once #35565 lands, a formula can also declare `percent`, and an agent reading the skill would not offer it for a ratio formula such as budget used or gross margin.

## Done when
The list names `percent` with its convention in one or two sentences: the value is a fraction (`0.25` shows `25%`, so the expression divides and does not multiply by 100), unless the formula declares `max` above 1, in which case it is percentage points. Its `scale` counts the decimal places of the displayed percentage. It is declared by the author and never inferred. The skill's evals still pass.

Blocked-by: #35047 (the key must be on `main` first)

## Grade
p3 · area:data · domain:skills. A skill reader may miss a declarable return type; no data is wrong.
